description: This file is a source code file for a React/Next.js project. It defines a page component for displaying detailed information about a recipe, including metadata fetching, dynamic route handling, and UI rendering.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Generates static route parameters for all recipes based on their slugs by fetching all recipes and mapping their slugs into route params.

methods.name: RecipeDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component for rendering a recipe detail page. It retrieves the recipe by slug, handles not found cases, and renders the recipe details with images, metadata, ingredients, and steps.
